interpretation_boundaries: No single overall quality score is produced

Empirical privacy diagnostics do not prove anonymity or formal privacy
TRTS is diagnostic and does not replace held-out-real TSTR evidence

metric_registry.utility: TRTR baseline, TSTR transfer and optional TRTS diagnostic
